tables.name: accounts_providerdocument

tables.name: accounts_providerprofile
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "accounts_providerprofile" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "bio" text NOT NULL, "profile_image" varchar(100) NULL, "specialization" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "experience_years" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("experience_years" >= 0), "hourly_rate" decimal NULL, "address" text NOT NULL, "latitude" decimal NULL, "longitude" decimal NULL, "total_orders" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("total_orders" >= 0), "completed_orders" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("completed_orders" >= 0), "average_rating" decimal NOT NULL, "is_available" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "user_id" bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "accounts_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "admin_notes" text NOT NULL, "availability" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "city" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "display_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL, "district" varchar(100) NOT NULL, "email" varchar(254) NOT NULL, "experience" text NOT NULL, "phone" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "qualifications" text NOT NULL, "service_radius" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("service_radius" >= 0), "verification_status" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "verified_at" datetime NULL, "verified_by_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "accounts_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "location_city_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "core_city" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "location_district_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "core_district" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)

tables.name: accounts_providerprofile_qualification_choices

tables.name: accounts_providerprofile_specializations

tables.name: accounts_providerverificationrequest
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE "accounts_providerverificationrequest" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "status" varchar(30) NOT NULL, "admin_note" text NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" datetime NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "provider_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "accounts_providerprofile" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "reviewed_by_id" bigint NULL REFERENCES "accounts_user" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "profile_snapshot" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("profile_snapshot") OR "profile_snapshot" IS NULL)), "submitted_at" datetime NULL)

tables.name: accounts_providerverificationrequest_documents
